lane_resolution: The supplied prompt contains no separate single method paragraph assigning this session a lane (same irregularity recorded since registry/preregistration.json). Exactly one lane is selected and frozen here before any H86F surface, fit, canary, holdout or placement computation. Read-only H33/fleet forensics and band-physics spot checks performed before this freeze are audits of pinned prior artifacts, not lane experiments; they are reported in docs/evidence/h86f-h33-forensics.json.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Regularized Laplace gravity-curvature dipole over a buried basement step, with basement/gravity polarity concordance
layers: training_features.tif Band 11 iso_grav_anom_vg (pixel-verified signed +dg/drow_south = -dg/dy_north; NOT a vertical derivative)
training_features.tif Band 5 iso_grav_anom_slope (control only; pixel-verified hypot(Band 11, Band 18))
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Footprint-masked Gaussian-regularized (sigma=5 px = 500 m) Laplace vertical gravity curvature in image coordinates gzz = -(d_x Band18 + d_row Band11), QC-checked against -Laplacian(Band 13) (measured r=+0.8952 at sigma=5 on the 30-px-eroded interior in the pre-freeze audit). For 8 strike azimuths, an antisymmetric flank-pairing response sqrt(clip(flank_plus * -flank_minus, 0, None)) (and reverse polarity) of gzz at +/-2..4 px across strike, strike-smoothed over 9 px; E1 multiplies by a preregistered soft polarity gate (1.0 if the Band 15 basement-depth flank step and Band 13 gravity flank step have opposite signs, else 0.25).
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted pre-Tertiary paleovalley margins or buried caldera moat walls infilled by low-density sediments; gravity-basement inversion artifacts. Band 15 and Band 13 share gravity-inversion ancestry (measured interior r=-0.6396), so polarity concordance is a sign gate, never independent additive evidence.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: A basement fault buried under basin fill steps the density interface and therefore produces a paired gzz dipole with a zero crossing over the step even where Holocene cover has erased any scarp a photo/DEM mapper could catalogue. The USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue is Quaternary/surface-expression based; a pure subsurface step detector is blind to that selection.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: No executed lane in this repo computes the divergence of the signed (Band 18, -Band 11) gravity vector: prior lanes used Band 11/18 as scalar/vertical gradients under the embedded header labels, unsigned cross-gradients (GMC), raw flank steps without gzz (SPBT-v1, negative), or gravity scalars inside supervised stacks (GFCO/KSLB/CTHB/CCTX/RIDF). The gzz identity itself was only numerically verified (docs/evidence/band-physics-verification-20261024.json) and listed as an unrun SPBT extension in registry/h86c_hypotheses.json; this lane is that extension, reported as such, with the dipole-pairing (not step magnitude) as the test statistic.
ranked_hypotheses.cost: low-medium (deterministic, no fitting, no external data)
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Competition-native bands only (owner mirror sha256 4371c82e3b8339b807bdffcf4ef59a225520fe2988d521be208ae33743123bc5, re-verified this session; not organizer-authenticated). Physics basis: USGS GeoDAWN DOI 10.5066/P93LGLVQ; Laplace equation in the source-free half-space.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_rank_basis: Highest qualitative priority: it is the only ranked candidate whose statistic is specific to a step (paired opposite-sign curvature lobes) rather than to any edge, it needs no external bytes, and gravity/basement bands are present at full footprint coverage. No numerical DTI gain is projected.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Broad-warp detrended-elevation profile-curvature sign-flip persistence
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Second directional derivative of Band 12 at sigma=3 and 6 px; require a signed curvature zero crossing with opposite-sign flanks persisting >=900 m along strike, explicitly at broader scale than 1-m lidar scarps.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Hogback dip slopes, pluvial shoreline treads, and lithologic dip-slope breaks.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Pre-Quaternary bedrock faults can retain a broad flexural warp after the discrete scarp has degraded below catalogue mapping thresholds.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Prior topographic lanes use slope magnitude (Band 19), relief, or 1-m lidar sharp scarps; none tests a signed broad-warp curvature sign flip on Band 12 as a standalone surface.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Competition-native bands only; no external data required.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_rank_basis: Cheap and topographic signals are historically strong, but the transform family (DEM curvature) is heavily represented in the fleet, so lane-drift (rho/overlap) risk is higher than for GZZD. Not run this session.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Hydrothermal magnetite-destruction trough with pairwise paleo-vent/sinter collinearity (competition-native subset)
layers: training_features.tif Band 6 tc (pixel-verified radiometric Total Count)
DOE GDR 1391 paleo_geothermal / volcanic-vent point compilations (CC BY 4.0)
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Strike-continuous RTP minima with positive cross-strike second derivative and magnetic shoulders, co-located with Band 17 conductance and pairwise <=6 km collinear point alignments; phase/point-scrambled controls.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Remanent/reversed-polarity volcanic units, primary felsic lithology, playa clay conductance, survey seams.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Hydrothermal upflow along a blind fault destroys magnetite and deposits sinter at the surface without building a mappable scarp.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Previously proposed as H86E-HMDC (registry/h86c_hypotheses.json rank 3) and never run; CTHB used radial point halos, not pairwise collinear geodesics or an RTP-trough (negative-polarity) statistic.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Official source named: DOE GDR submission 1391, https://gdr.openei.org/submissions/1391 (CC BY 4.0). In-footprint wellspring/vent CSVs are SHA-pinned in research/h86d_extended_manifest.json (owner GitHub mirrors), but the paleo-sinter and 2-m probe archives were not re-obtained and hash-verified in THIS sandbox session, so this hypothesis is NOT proposed as viable to run here until those exact bytes are restored and pinned.
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_rank_basis: Geothermally the most specific, but point compilations are sparse inside the footprint and implementation cost is the highest per expected covered truth cell. Not run this session.

ranked_hypotheses.name: Geodetic strain-localization boundary (tensor-gradient ridge)
ranked_hypotheses.transform: Gradient-magnitude ridge of the strain-rate second invariant with orientation coherence, i.e. the boundary between actively straining and rigid blocks, rather than the scalar strain value.
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: GPS/InSAR interpolation and smoothing artifacts; volcanic or anthropogenic deformation sources.
ranked_hypotheses.uncatalogued_rationale: Interseismic strain concentrates on locked faults whether or not they have a mapped Quaternary trace.
ranked_hypotheses.novelty: Bands 4/7/8 entered GFCO/KSLB/WVB and the blind-geothermal lane only as scalar values or rank averages; no lane uses a tensor-gradient localization ridge as the standalone statistic.
ranked_hypotheses.official_data: Competition-native bands only (INGENIOUS strain compilation, DOI 10.1785/0220220153 via https://gbcge.org/current-projects/ingenious/).
ranked_hypotheses.expected_dti_rank_basis: Lowest priority: geodetic strain grids are smooth at multi-kilometre scale relative to the 300 m metric kernel, so per-dot kernel credit is expected to be diffuse. Not run this session.

arms.hypothesis: A buried basement step produces a paired regularized gzz dipole whose polarity agrees with the basement-depth/gravity flank steps.
arms.transform: gzz dipole pairing (8 azimuths, +/-2..4 px flanks, 9-px strike smoothing) times soft polarity gate (1.0 concordant / 0.25 discordant). Candidate arm.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Paleovalley or caldera-moat margin infilled by low-density sediment; inversion artifact.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Subsurface step detection is independent of surface scarp preservation and of the mapped catalogue.
arms.novelty: First executed divergence-of-signed-gravity-vector (gzz dipole) lane in this repo.
arms.official_data: Pinned 19-band owner mirror only; no external layer acquired.

arms.hypothesis: The gzz dipole pairing alone, without basement/gravity polarity concordance, carries the signal.
arms.transform: Identical dipole pairing to E1 with the polarity gate fixed at 1.0. Mechanism ablation.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Any paired density-edge curvature, including unfaulted contacts.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Ablation isolating whether polarity concordance adds information beyond step curvature.
arms.novelty: Preregistered ablation, not a separate submission strategy.

arms.hypothesis: If dipole pairing is causal, it must beat the conventional unsigned gravity-gradient edge at identical budget and emission.
arms.transform: Gaussian-smoothed (sigma=2 px) Band 5 magnitude as the ranking surface. Negative/edge control.
arms.non_fault_mimic: Unfaulted lithologic density contacts and broad basin margins.
arms.uncatalogued_rationale: Control is catalogue-blind by construction; it prices the added value of signed pairing over edge presence.
arms.novelty: Preregistered negative control, not a new submission strategy.

emission: Shared gems57.emit.emit_decimated (tile_px=3) on rank01(surface) + emit_prefix at 44090 dots; holdout allowed = footprint & (distance to visible catalogue > 3 px); final allowed = footprint & (distance to full catalogue > 3 px); binary unit dots; zeros outside footprint via the shared fail-closed writer (no clipping, no nodata tag).

controls: R0_D28_visible_collar (fold-fair geometry control rebuilt on this split)
historical same-split comparator E3_kslb_noisyor_44k from docs/evidence/lane86c_results.json (not re-run)

promotion: verdict promote (to the separate human selector only, never a slot authorization) requires ALL of: candidate HOLDOUT-DTI beats the historical same-split best with separated 95% CIs; paired HOLDOUT-DTI delta vs the best preregistered control has 95% CI strictly > 0; every leakage canary <= 0.90; surface and final-dots registry gates pass on a complete error-free scan; PA-86-02 gate_pass true; shared writer + independent on-disk validator pass. Otherwise verdict negative and DO NOT SUBMIT. No weekly slot is used by this lane in any outcome.
evidence_labelling: Every score-like number is HOLDOUT-DTI (evaluator version, withheld positives, 95% CI), LEAKAGE-CANARY, REGISTRY-MEASUREMENT, LOCAL-FORMAT-VALIDATION, or OWNER-REPORTED. No projection is written as a score. ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED is reserved for a submission-page receipt, which this lane does not obtain.
